topArticle.title: More than 100 dead after goldmine collapses in Central African Republic

The collapse was caused by a landslide, while local officials say the death toll is likely to rise as recovery efforts continue
More than 100 people have died after an artisanal goldmine at a small village in western Central African Republic (CAR) caved in due to a landslide, local officials and aid workers said on Wednesday.
The landslide happened on Tuesday afternoon in the village of Zamboye, about 50km (31 miles) from the town of Baboua and close to the border of Cameroon. Footage on social media appeared to show an avalanche of sand descend on a group of people, likely the miners, and cover them.

topArticle.title: Nanda Malini, one of Sri Lanka's best known voices of protest, dies at 82
topArticle.description: Once banned from national airwaves, Nanda Malini was known for her songs about social justice.
topArticle.titleJa: スリランカで最もよく知られた抗議の声、ナンダ・マリニ氏が82歳で死去
topArticle.summary: スリランカの社会正義を歌い、かつて放送禁止処分を受けたナンダ・マリニ氏が82歳で亡くなった。

topArticle.title: Thai teen found in suitcase died from suffocation, police reveal
topArticle.description: New evidence sheds more light on the death of Tunchanok Donholma, who was allegedly murdered in June.
topArticle.titleJa: スーツケース内で発見されたタイの10代女性は窒息死、警察が発表
topArticle.summary: 6月に殺害されたとされるタイのトゥンチャノック・ドンホルマさんの死因が窒息であったことが、警察の新たな証拠で明らかになった。

topArticle.title: Trump wants to be friends with Kim - but South Korea could pay the price
topArticle.description: US military exercises with South Korea end early on Friday, at a time when the North is in a position of strength.
topArticle.titleJa: トランプ氏、金氏との友好を望むが、その代償を韓国が払う可能性
topArticle.summary: トランプ氏が金氏との関係強化を望む一方、米韓軍事演習が早期終了し、北朝鮮が優位な状況で韓国が影響を受ける可能性が指摘されている。

topArticle.title: United Kingdom launches safeguard investigation on polyethylene terephthalate
topArticle.description: On 5 August 2026, the United Kingdom notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day, a safeguard investigation on imports of certain polyethylene terephthalate (PET).
topArticle.titleJa: 英国、ポリエチレンテレフタレートに関するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: 英国が2026年8月5日に特定のポリエチレンテレフタレート（PET）輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知した。

topArticle.title: WTO panel issues report regarding Turkish measures on EVs and other types of vehicles
topArticle.description: On 28 July, the WTO circulated the panel report in the case brought by China in "Türkiye — Measures Concerning Electric Vehicles and Other Types of Vehicles from China" (DS629).
topArticle.titleJa: WTOパネル、トルコによるEVなど車両に関する措置に関する報告書を発表
topArticle.summary: WTOは、中国が提起した「トルコ—電気自動車およびその他の中国製車両に関する措置」のパネル報告書を公表した。

topArticle.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
topArticle.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
topArticle.titleJa: リトアニア、途上国およびLDCの貿易スキル向上支援に3万ユーロを拠出
topArticle.summary: リトアニアが、開発途上国や後発開発途上国の政府職員向け訓練プログラムを支援するため、WTOグローバル信託基金に3万ユーロを拠出した。

topArticle.title: Uzbekistan reaffirms 2026 WTO accession goal, thanks members for continuing engagement
topArticle.description: Uzbekistan reaffirmed its determination to complete its WTO accession process within 2026 at a meeting of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan on 27 and 28 July, soon after its last meeting in March. The head of Uzbekistan's delegation, Chief Negotiator Azizbek Urunov, stressed that maintaining a strong pace of engagement and addressing members' remaining concerns will be critical to bringing the accession process to a successful conclusion.
topArticle.titleJa: ウズベキスタン、2026年WTO加盟目標を再確認し、継続的な関与に感謝
topArticle.summary: ウズベキスタンが2026年中のWTO加盟完了への決意を再確認し、交渉ペース維持と懸念事項解決が成功に不可欠であると強調した。
